children: China's commerce ministry on Monday announced preliminary anti-dumping measures on imports of dichlorosilane, a chemical compound used in semiconductor manufacturing, from Japan.
Starting Tuesday, importers of Japanese dichlorosilane must provide cash deposits to customs. Rates were set at 99.2% for Shin-Etsu Chemical
, 80.8% for Denal Silane and 99.2% for other Japanese producers, the ministry said in a statement.
